title: PACTEL ATWS-11 held-out compression response

source.title: NUREG/IA-0231: An Assessment of TRACE V4.160 Code Against PACTEL ATWS-10-13 and ATWS-20-21 Pressurizer Experiments
source.author: E. Takasuo
source.publisher: U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission / VTT Processes
source.sourceKind: Red measured pressure in Figure 6; black dashed TRACE predictions are excluded.
source.redistribution: Only numerical facts, original metadata and extraction/comparison code are distributed. The PDF, artwork and TRACE input deck are not bundled or relicensed.

experiment.facility: PACTEL, Lappeenranta University of Technology, Finland

operatorEvents.event: Insurge stops; draining starts (outside selected window)

experiment.windowReason: ATWS-11's outsurge mass-flow magnitude is not published in the tables or printed input decks. The comparison stops before draining rather than inferring the missing boundary from pressure.
experiment.independence: Different experiment from ATWS-10, in the same facility and publication. ATWS-11 pressure is withheld from the model developer until a candidate hash freeze for this development cycle.
experiment.qualification: The report's general mechanisms were already available during development; this is a development-separated response holdout, not historically blind external validation or certification.

extraction.method: Decode the sole embedded RGB image on PDF page 18; retain only the red Pactel measurement path below the legend and only columns needed by the prespecified pre-drain window. Linearly resample median path height between adjacent represented pixel columns.
extraction.redSelection: R>=240 and R-G>=50 and R-B>=50. Rows 120..614 exclude the legend. Disjoint red branches in a required column are rejected.
extraction.readingGridQualification: 291 correlated positions along a published curve, not 291 independent instrument acquisitions. Six decimals preserve reproducibility, not measurement precision.
extraction.endpointPolicy: No extrapolation. Discard 0-4 s; no values after 295 s enter this reference. The time allowance is clipped at the available reference-window edges.

publishedBoundaryModel.classification: Conditional replay combining ATWS-11 table values with explicitly inherited ATWS-10 input-deck approximations; not a complete raw measured input record.
publishedBoundaryModel.geometryAndWallParameters: Shared unchanged with the frozen PactelPressurizer model: 8.8 m height, 0.1397 m inner diameter, 0.0143 m wall, 3.44 W/(m2 K) exterior coefficient, 298 K ambient. Constitutive assumptions are separately recorded by the model.
publishedBoundaryModel.forcingQualification: One-second ramps and 547 K inlet/wall conditions follow the printed ATWS-10 input pattern; they are not additional ATWS-11 measurements. Fluid temperatures correspond to the same 5.9 MPa initial pressure. No input is recovered from pressure response.

measurementUncertainty.basis: Section 4.1 printed page 13/PDF page 16 states this maximum pressure-measurement error also applies to the other experiments in the report.
measurementUncertainty.distribution: Unspecified; this is a reported bound, not a standard deviation.
measurementUncertainty.conditionalEnvelopeBasis: Arithmetic sum of 0.094 MPa reported pressure bound and 0.0142857 MPa graphical allowance, combined with a separate ±1.440576 s graphical-time window. Not a confidence interval or complete uncertainty budget.

calibrationAndHoldout.parameterFitting: No ATWS-11 pressure value may select coefficients, wall properties, mesh, initial conditions, boundary timing, offsets, or the model revision.
calibrationAndHoldout.acceptance: Report raw discrepancies and descriptive conditional-envelope coverage separately from numerical checks. No whole-plant validation pass is inferred.

limitations: This is a PACTEL component experiment, not a 1000 MWe PWR operating-plant transient or operator-training qualification.

The model developer was kept separate from ATWS-11 response values during this development cycle, but the same publication's general discussion was already known. This is not an externally certified blind study.
Only the compression phase is scored. ATWS-11 outsurge magnitude is unavailable and has not been invented; the subsequent expansion response is not validated.
The 1 s extraction grid samples a plotted curve; positions are correlated and original acquisition timestamps/calibration data are unavailable.
Boundary ramp duration, inlet temperature and initial wall/fluid temperatures partly reuse ATWS-10 assumptions. Their ATWS-11 uncertainties are not documented.
The conditional pressure envelope is incomplete because input, geometry and model uncertainties are not fully characterized.
No pressure offset correction or time alignment is applied, including any mismatch between the measured initial table and plotted curve.
A successful numerical balance does not establish agreement with measurements, and the held-out event cannot establish full-plant fidelity.
